# Overview of projects

You have now learned nearly everything there is to know about technical aspects
of _slendr_ modeling and seen many different examples of various techniques to
apply simulations in your own work. All that remains now is for you to gain your
own experience through practice.

Here is a selection of small projects representing case studies from various
contexts of population genetics, many of which should be immediately applicable
in your own work (certainly the simulation and computational techniques will be,
if not the exact same statistics). There are also a couple of opportunities for
practicing on exercises which are more in line with the exercises we went
through until this point, just in case you still feel a little uncertain about
programming simulations. On the opposite side of the spectrum, there are also
suggestions for much more open-ended and more ambitious project ideas, in case
you feel like doing an extra challenge!
